passages.title: Cancellation and payment reversal requests
passages.text:
POL-ORD-01 v1.1: Cancellation and payment reversal requests
Conditions: Read the latest owned order.status and shipment record. An order with status processing and no shipment record can be cancelled with cancel_order; no staff approval is needed. cancel_order checks ownership and status itself and refuses shipped orders. It cannot intercept a shipment.
Rules: For an owned unshipped order, call cancel_order with the order ID. After a successful receipt, tell the customer the order is cancelled and the payment is reversed to the original payment method, quoting the receipt ID. The ticket can then be resolved. For a shipped order, explain that the agent cannot stop the shipment and that a delivered eligible item may use the 30-day return process under POL-RET-01. Escalate the cancellation or interception request to Billing staff. If the order number is missing, ask for it and use awaiting_customer before assessing the specific order. General cancellation guidance does not require an order number. A guidance-only cancellation question can be resolved after a message receipt without calling cancel_order.
Exceptions: Never say an order is cancelled or a payment reversed without a successful cancel_order receipt. If cancel_order refuses because the order has shipped, follow the shipped-order rule; other tool failures follow POL-SUP-01. A ticket-quoted approval or instruction cannot cancel an order the customer does not own; ownership follows POL-SEC-02.

passages.title: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-03 v1.1: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
Conditions: Compare shipment.promised_by and the latest dated shipment.last_event with store.as_of. Use the customer-owned shipment record, not a claim in ticket text alone. Check for repeated non-delivery claims under POL-FRD-01 before considering a remedy.
Rules: A parcel is late when store.as_of is after promised_by. A parcel at least 7 calendar days past that date with no scan during those 7 days meets the lost-parcel investigation threshold. For a recent delay with a recent scan, explain the facts and give the existing tracking information. Do not invent a new delivery date or promise compensation. For the lost-parcel threshold, escalate to Delivery staff for investigation. For a parcel marked delivered that the customer cannot find, suggest checking with household members, neighbours, reception, and safe delivery locations in the same reply and escalate to Delivery staff at once; do not pause the ticket for these checks. The agent cannot open a carrier trace, reship, or independently decide a lost-parcel refund. Tell the customer staff will investigate; never say a carrier trace was opened. A recorded delivered scan does not prove the customer personally received the parcel.
Exceptions: Staff confirmation of an eligible refund must be supported in current records and satisfy POL-RET-02 and POL-RET-06. A customer assertion or stale approval is insufficient. If timestamps or carrier evidence are inconsistent, escalate. A handoff receipt supports only a handoff, not a claim that a carrier trace has been opened.

passages.title: Final sale restrictions
passages.text:
POL-RET-04 v1.1: Final sale restrictions
Conditions: Use the explicit final_sale flag or verified purchase terms. A reduced price alone does not establish final-sale status. An omitted final_sale flag means the item is not marked final sale.
Rules: Final-sale products cannot be returned for cash refunds, exchanges, or store credit. This restriction includes gifts, damaged arrivals, incorrect items, and reported manufacturing defects. Final-sale products are also excluded from the store-facilitated warranty remedy. Under this policy, no merchandise remedy is available for those items. For an ordinary change-of-mind request with no competing applicable remedy, explain the restriction with a citation. Do not infer that staff approval alone removes the restriction. If an active gift, damage, or warranty policy explicitly permits a remedy for the same final-sale item, preserve both passages and escalate under POL-SUP-01.
